q: How do slag and dust enter a ferro alloy plant's carbon mass balance?
title: Ferro alloy: slag and dust carbon
short: Carbon leaving in slag, bag filter dust or sludge was not emitted, so subtract it in the mass balance. Multiply tonnes of each stream by its measured carbon content. If you assume zero, say so and show it is small.
audience: Ferrochrome, ferromanganese and silico-manganese plants preparing CBAM or buyer carbon figures

p: Leaving carbon out of the outputs side overstates emissions; counting it without data understates them. A verifier will want to see either a measurement or evidence that the stream is negligible.

ul: Slag tonnes per month and carbon content from periodic samples.
Dust and sludge collected, with carbon content, if they are sold or landfilled.
Carbon in the alloy from product analysis, which is usually the largest output term.

p: If dust goes back into the furnace, its carbon is not an output. Count it only when it leaves the installation.
